about: Black Ops' Ray Gun model, read from the player's own Black Ops (OpenAssetTools' Unlinker) and built onto the Cyberpunk Militech Omaha's meshes (WolvenKit import) on each Play. The Omaha's other parts are hidden, so the gun shows only the Ray Gun.

columns.bo_zone: Black Ops zone (zone\Common) holding the weapon
columns.bo_weapon: Black Ops weapon whose world model is used
columns.cp_donor_mesh: Cyberpunk mesh replaced by the Ray Gun
columns.cp_hide_prefix: depot path prefix of the donor's other meshes (every .mesh starting with it, except the donor, is emptied)
columns.fit_scale: size multiplier after fitting to the donor's length
columns.tested_in_game: true once seen in a match

rows.source: ray_gun_zm and its world model weapon_usa_ray_gun seen in the player's common_zombie.ff (test logs); Omaha meshes from WolvenKit's path list
